method: Read full candidate source and actual git diff with surrounding context, then compare baseline changed paragraphs directly. Author mapping not used as proof.

findings.section: R4 Confirm gate / Composition with the topology-write dial
findings.baseline: No appetite level auto-creates a container outside the L4 accepted-root envelope; therefore the whole rehome apply sits behind this gate at every appetite.
findings.candidate: Confirmation floor gates the whole apply at every appetite outside the L4 accepted-root envelope.
findings.issue: Moves the L4 qualification from the container auto-create rule onto the rehome confirmation gate itself. It introduces a possible ungated L4 rehome reading, conflicting with the unchanged unconditional R4 heading and autonomous zero-write fallback.
findings.required_correction: Keep the whole rehome apply gated at every appetite, and describe the existing container/L4 exception separately as the baseline did.

findings.candidate: With that same condition, offer the mode conversationally.
findings.issue: Changes optional conversational offer into an imperative.
findings.required_correction: Restore may offer while retaining explicit rehome argument as the deterministic mode selector.
